item.title: Crookston School Board offers Superintendent job to Jason Stanoch, who declines the offer
item.description: The Crookston School Board voted to offer Jason Stanoch the school district’s superintendent position. Jason is a high school principal in Bemidji. Mr. Stanoch has declined the offer. The school board will now begin to review its options as it moves forward.
